_note: Implementation provenance of the sixteen configurations (CACAIE revision, R1-minor-3, R2-4). Source of Supplementary Table S7 (code/tools/make_provenance_table.py). Compiled 2026-10-30 from the dumped training configs (work_dirs/matrix_50ep/<dataset>/<model>/*/vis_data/config.py in the mmsegmentation checkout), the wrapper code, and the upstream repositories (gh api); every model was rebuilt from its dumped config and its parameter count matched Table 4. `after` = the row is a locally derived configuration of the cited design (Table 4 marks it); verify_claims.py checks that Table 4 marks exactly these rows.

code_source_values.framework: the framework's own implementation of the published architecture (mmsegmentation / mmpretrain)
code_source_values.definition_only: the authors' released network definition only (no training code, weights or license)
code_source_values.description: reimplemented from the paper; no code was released

models.name: ConvNeXt-XLarge
models.departures: UPerNet head; 512 by 512 input; common optimizer instead of the layer-decay recipe

models.name: U-Net
models.departures: framework variant (batch norm, interpolation upsampling); no auxiliary head

models.name: Crack-ShuttleNet
models.departures: gated instead of scalar memory connections; boundary loss; 9.7 M instead of 58.3 M parameters; RGB instead of 2D+3D input; cross-entropy and Dice instead of focal loss

models.name: DeepLabV3+ (R50)
models.departures: framework variant (deep stem, output stride 8, auxiliary head)

models.name: RINDNet
models.departures: single-map edge variant used as a segmentor; final sigmoid removed; BCE and Dice instead of the attention loss

models.name: CarNet
models.departures: released source unchanged; BCE and Dice instead of BCE; input scaled to [-1,1]

models.name: DeepCrack fast-fuse
models.check: published order trained under the same protocol (Supplementary Section S7)

models.name: DTrC-Net
models.departures: unreleased self-pretrained 256-d Transformer branch replaced by public DeiT-tiny (192-d); network run at 256 by 256

models.name: RestorMixer
models.departures: restoration decoder replaced by a segmentation head

models.name: MixerCSeg modified
models.departures: wider encoder and decoder; attention in two stages; no routing or HoG branch; group normalization; low-resolution fusion and simplified prediction head; foreground-weighted loss

models.name: MixerCSeg faithful
models.departures: 36 HoG bins, as in the released code (the released weights use 180)
models.check: layer-by-layer agreement with the released code on the released weights (Supplementary Section S8)

models.name: MambaVision
models.weights: none (the released segmentation recipe loads ImageNet-1k)
models.departures: UPerNet heads replaced by a lighter fusion head
